text:
maria: Heads-up — Hephaestus14b int4 canary is hitting intermittent OOMs under our defaults (batch=8, max_new_tokens=512). Observed on two machines in us-west1.
ernie: Ugh. Any logs?
maria: Pasted excerpt: ```
[E] oom: alloc failed 3145728000
[E] kv_cache: slot_count=2048 free_slots=60
[info] gpu_mem_peak=43.7GB total=48GB
```
devon: Sounds like fragmentation + high max_new. At 512 we keep large KV pages resident. Prefetch being enabled increases concurrent resident allocations.
sasha: Quick mitigation plan: reduce default max_new_tokens to 256 for the canary, disable prefetch, and set kv_trim_threshold=0.15. Anyone object? :eyes:
jen: LGTM. Also propose soft_slot_reserve=0.06 so coldstarts don't spray slots.
infra-bot: deploy requested by sasha to canary pool (pool=hep-canary, commit=heph-int4-v1). ETA ~5m.
maria: Applying changes now on two hosts. Config used: ```
serving.runtime.batch_size: 8
serving.runtime.max_new_tokens: 256
serving.runtime.prefetch: false
serving.runtime.kv_trim_threshold: 0.15
serving.runtime.soft_slot_reserve: 0.06
```
devon: Also add adaptive clamp: if prompt_len >= 1500 then cap max_new_tokens to 128. Prevents pathological combos.
sasha: I can add that as a request-time rule in routing policy. Draft rule: - match: prompt_len >= 1500   set: max_new_tokens=128
jen: After the change mem_peak dropped to ~38.8GB and no OOMs for ~45m. Still monitoring.
maria: Confirmed — no OOMs on those hosts for the last 1h. Perf tradeoff: p95 latency +10-14% on long-gen tails, throughput stable.
ernie: Can we run a QA eval comparing int4-v1 with max_new 256 vs 512 to check generation quality on long outputs?
sasha: Scheduling eval job (eval-suite: regen-long-context). Results expected in ~3h.
devon: Long-term fix: allocator slab compaction needs work; fragmentation is the root cause. For now conservative defaults + kv-trim and soft reserves are good.
jen: I'll add a runbook entry in ops-playbooks: "Hephaestus14b int4 onboarding — memory surge mitigations" with config and rollback steps.
maria: If canary stays clean for 6h we stage rollout to dedicated pools with a 24h monitor. :thumbsup:
